craftoffice.consent.title: CraftOffice on this server
craftoffice.consent.body:
This server uses CraftOffice: proximity camera and microphone, like an office.

• Camera and microphone start off every time you join. Turn them on with %1$s (camera) and %2$s (microphone).
• Audio and video go straight to the players near you, never through the game server. They can see your IP address.
• To find a path to the others, the game asks: %3$s.
• Nothing is recorded.
• %4$s stops all capture at once. Set this key in Controls.
